title: CloudTrail->OpenSearch index rotation and retention Terraform module with health reconciler
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Build a reusable Terraform module that manages CloudTrail->OpenSearch audit indices' lifecycle (rotation, ILM policies, snapshot-to-S3 before delete), provides a reconciliation-based healthcheck controller, and a safe upgrade path for existing private VPC deployments.

Scope: The module will provision:
- OpenSearch index templates and ILM policies tuned for variable ingest rates (hot-warm-cold phases).
- Index rollover aliases and automated rollovers based on size/time.
- Snapshot lifecycle to S3 (with configurable bucket, KMS key, and cross-account role options).
- Terraform-managed CloudTrail subscription/stream to delivery stream or Kinesis -> ingestion pipeline.
- A small Lambda-based reconciler (declarative) that runs every 15 min to detect ILM drift, stuck rollovers, or failed snapshots and emits metrics/alerts.
- Healthcheck dashboards/alerts wired to console (CloudWatch metrics + alert topics).

Design decisions and trade-offs:
- Prefer index rollover + snapshots over immediate deletion to avoid data-loss during transient spikes. This increases storage cost but reduces incident risk.
- Use Terraform to manage CRDs (index templates, ILM policies) but surface a lightweight reconciler for runtime correction (avoid long-running k8s operators in private VPCs).
- Snapshot cadence default: daily with 7-day cold retention before Glacier archival (configurable).
- Upgrade path for existing indices: if templates change in incompatible ways, prefer alias-based reindexing with an automated reindex job (optional) rather than in-place policy edits. Reindexing is slower but safer for format changes.

Module API (high level):
- Variables: opensearch_endpoint, cluster_role_arn, s3_snapshot_bucket, kms_key_id, retention_days_hot, retention_days_warm, rollover_size_mb, use_cross_account_snapshot (bool), enable_reconciler (bool), alert_sns_topic.
- Outputs: index_template_name, ilm_policy_id, snapshot_repo_name, reconciler_lambda_arn.

Acceptance criteria:
- Terraform module can be instantiated in a test VPC and produce an index template + ILM policy that rolls over and snapshots automatically.
- Reconciler detects manual drift (we will test by temporarily deleting an ILM policy) and recreates it, emitting a CloudWatch metric 'audit.ilm.reconciler.failures' when remediation fails.
- Snapshot repository validates with credentials and can restore a snapshot to a fresh index in a recovery test.
- Module includes a documented upgrade playbook for 2 scenarios: policy tweak (in-place) and mapping change (reindex + alias swap).
- End-to-end test run in our CI (see links) completes within staging account without human intervention.

Compatibility notes:
- Designed for OpenSearch 2.x and compatible with AWS-managed ES where APIs overlap. Tests must assert version compatibility and fail loudly if mismatch.

Operational runbook (short):
- If reconciler emits >3 failures in 1h: escalate to SRE, check IAM role for snapshots, inspect OpenSearch cluster health.
- If snapshot failures persist: run manual snapshot and, if needed, run emergency index export to S3 via reindex-from-remote.

Security & compliance:
- All S3 snapshot buckets must be encrypted with configured KMS key and have access logging enabled.
- Option to enable cross-account snapshot role requires explicit acceptance in install docs.

Notes on uniqueness: This ticket focuses on the reconciliation/health layer and safe index-level upgrade strategy, rather than just the TF templates. Existing tickets handled retention policies and shipping; this one formalizes recovery-first behavior and a Terraform-first orchestration with a small runtime reconciler.
